cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(seekdb_hipvs_bridge LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
find_package(hip REQUIRED CONFIG)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
set(HIPVS_ROOT "" CACHE PATH "Installed hipVS C API SDK prefix")
find_path(HIPVS_INCLUDE_DIR cuvs/neighbors/cagra.h HINTS "${HIPVS_ROOT}/include" REQUIRED)
find_library(HIPVS_C_LIBRARY NAMES cuvs_c HINTS "${HIPVS_ROOT}/lib" "${HIPVS_ROOT}/lib64" REQUIRED)
find_library(HIPVS_LIBRARY NAMES cuvs HINTS "${HIPVS_ROOT}/lib" "${HIPVS_ROOT}/lib64" REQUIRED)
set(SEEKDB_HIPVS_SOURCE_REVISION "unknown" CACHE STRING "Verified installed hipVS source commit, or unknown")
string(LENGTH "${SEEKDB_HIPVS_SOURCE_REVISION}" SEEKDB_HIPVS_REVISION_LENGTH)
if(NOT SEEKDB_HIPVS_SOURCE_REVISION STREQUAL "unknown" AND
   (NOT SEEKDB_HIPVS_SOURCE_REVISION MATCHES "^[0-9a-fA-F]+$" OR
   NOT SEEKDB_HIPVS_REVISION_LENGTH EQUAL 40 OR
   SEEKDB_HIPVS_SOURCE_REVISION STREQUAL "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000"))
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Set SEEKDB_HIPVS_SOURCE_REVISION to the verified installed commit or unknown; a binary hash is not a source commit")
endif()
file(SHA256 "${HIPVS_C_LIBRARY}" HIPVS_C_LIBRARY_SHA256)
file(SHA256 "${HIPVS_LIBRARY}" HIPVS_LIBRARY_SHA256)
set(HIPVS_MANIFEST "source_revision=${SEEKDB_HIPVS_SOURCE_REVISION}\ninclude_dir=${HIPVS_INCLUDE_DIR}\nc_api_library=${HIPVS_C_LIBRARY}\nc_api_sha256=${HIPVS_C_LIBRARY_SHA256}\ncore_library=${HIPVS_LIBRARY}\ncore_sha256=${HIPVS_LIBRARY_SHA256}\n")
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/hipvs-build-manifest.txt" "${HIPVS_MANIFEST}")
message(STATUS "hipVS installed build manifest:\n${HIPVS_MANIFEST}")
add_library(seekdb_hipvs_bridge SHARED hipvs_bridge.cpp)
target_include_directories(seekdb_hipvs_bridge PRIVATE ../../src/oblib/lib/vector "${HIPVS_INCLUDE_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(seekdb_hipvs_bridge PRIVATE "${HIPVS_C_LIBRARY}" "${HIPVS_LIBRARY}" hip::host Threads::Threads)
target_compile_definitions(seekdb_hipvs_bridge PRIVATE
  SEEKDB_HIPVS_SOURCE_REVISION="${SEEKDB_HIPVS_SOURCE_REVISION}"
  SEEKDB_HIPVS_C_LIBRARY_SHA256="${HIPVS_C_LIBRARY_SHA256}")
set_target_properties(seekdb_hipvs_bridge PROPERTIES CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN ON)
if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "The optional hipVS worker requires Linux")
endif()
add_executable(seekdb_hipvs_worker hipvs_worker.cpp)
target_include_directories(seekdb_hipvs_worker PRIVATE ../../src/oblib/lib/vector)
target_link_libraries(seekdb_hipvs_worker PRIVATE ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
  # hipcc otherwise injects ROCm before main can close inherited descriptors.
  target_link_options(seekdb_hipvs_worker PRIVATE -no-hip-rt)
endif()
# Keep the default worker next to the bridge both in build and install trees.
install(TARGETS seekdb_hipvs_bridge seekdb_hipvs_worker LIBRARY DESTINATION lib RUNTIME DESTINATION lib)
install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/hipvs-build-manifest.txt" DESTINATION share/seekdb-hipvs)
